**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity) — Section 13.5 (p0208).**

- **Issue:** Section 13.5 expressly characterizes the Termination for Convenience Fee and Termination for Cause Fee as liquidated damages payable by *us*. Those fees are a percentage of the Estimated Remaining Value (remaining months × the greater of the Monthly Base Fee or trailing three-month average Fees) and are carved out of the Section 13.4 liability cap — so the deemed liquidated sum tracks the remaining contract value, well beyond the three-months'-fees fallback.
- **Direction check:** Confirmed Customer-payable; Section 11.2(B) (no fees where we terminate for M&I's default) benefits us and was not flagged.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** delete the deeming provision, with the three-month cap offered as fallback in the comment. The quantum of the termination fees themselves is left to the termination-for-convenience rule to avoid double-flagging.
